style: upbeat synth pop, bright female vocal, punchy drums, arpeggiated synths, 118 BPM, hopeful
lyrics:
[Verse]
We left the keys on the kitchen table
Drove until the signs ran out
Every station played the same old fable
And we sang it anyway, loud

[Chorus]
Run, run, into the morning
Nothing behind us worth a look
Run, run, no need for warning
We wrote the ending in our own book

[Outro]
In our own book
